row.reason: OUTFRONT sells physical out-of-home ad space (billboards, transit, digital screens) to brands and agencies. Ziff Davis is a digital media and internet company. It publishes online brands in technology, shopping, health and gaming, and it also sells cybersecurity and martech services. Both compete for brand advertising budgets, so the advertiser customer base overlaps. The products differ: online media properties and subscriptions versus owned physical display assets. Ziff Davis also has large consumer and subscription lines that OUTFRONT lacks. The result is partial overlap, not a direct competitor.
